name: render_ui
label: Render UI
description: Create, update or delete a read-only A2UI v0.9.1 result card through the host. To create, omit surface_id; the host assigns and returns it. Send messages in order: updateComponents, updateDataModel or deleteSurface. Include a plain-text fallback when creating a card. Success is reported only after host validation and persistence. Invalid parameters return a tool error; correct them or answer in text. Follow the host's card policy and catalog; this tool does not support interactive forms or actions.

surface_id.description: Handle returned by the host for a card in this conversation. Omit to create.

messages.description: A2UI v0.9.1 messages applied in order.

fallback.description: Plain-text version of the card. Required by the host when creating.
